20: Intendant - The duties of the Officers of the Town of Vernonburg shall be as follows: Intendant: The Intendant of the Town shall set agendas, preside over town meetings and administer all functions of the Town's business. The Intendant of the Town shall be responsible for and shall be in charge of the Town's finances and its day to day operations in line with the Council's yearly and/or special budgets. The Intendant's responsibilities include administering the Town's cash flow by being in charge of the receipt and disbursement of funds, borrowing of funds on a short-term basis and making other financial decisions necessary to ensure the responsible operation of the Town. The Intendant may not levy or raise taxes without a legal vote from Council. The Intendant may appoint any committees he deems necessary to carry out the business of the Town. Secretary - The Secretary of the Town shall keep the Minutes of the Town meetings. The Secretary of the Town shall maintain the Town minute book, execute and keep on record any documents required by law or action of Town Council. Treasurer - The Treasurer of the Town shall carry out the financial duties of the Town as per the directions of the Intendant. The Treasurer of the Town shall keep a current accounting of all the Town's finances as required by all applicable law. The Treasurer of the Town shall gather the Town's mail on a weekly basis and deliver it to the Intendant. The Treasurer of the Town shall report on the Town's finances at each Town meeting.

79: Sect.4-1. Definitions. Definitions. Regulated Activity. (a) Definitions. For the purpose of this Section, the following terms shall have the followins meanings: (1) "Regulated activity" means any activity which will, or which may reasonably be expected to, result in the discharge of dredged or fill material into waters of the United States excepting those activities exempted in section 404 of the Federal clean water Act. (2) "Wetland" means an area that is inundated or saturated by surface water or groundwater at a frequency and distribution sufficient to support, and under normal circumstances does support, a prevalence of vegetation typically adapted for life in saturated soil conditions, commonly known as hydrophytic vegetation. Wetlands generally include swamps, marshes, bogs and similar areas. (3) "Wetlands Map" means the current U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service National Wetlands Inventory maps for the Town of Vernonburg, Georgia. (4) "Wetland Protection District" means all wetlands within the jurisdiction of the Town of Vernonburg, Georgia as indicated on the Wetlands Map. Provided, however, that the Wetlands Map does not necessarily represent the boundaries ofjurisdictional wetlands within the Town of Vernonburg and cannot serye as a substitute for a delineation of wetland boundaries by the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, as required by Section 404 of the Clean Water Act, as amended. Any local government action under this ordinance does not relieve the land owner from federal or state permitting requirements. Sect. 4-2. Regulated Activity. A U.S. Army Corps of Engineers determination shall be required prior to the issuance of a permit for any regulated activity within the Wetland Protection District. If the Corps determines that wetlands are present and that a Section 404 Permit or Letter of Permission is required, no permit for the regulated activity will be issued until the Corps has issued the Section 404 permit or Letter of Permission. If the Corps determines that there are no wetlands present on the proposed development site, the Town of Vernonburg may proceed with its normal permitting procedures. { 8s69s. L }
